title: Brand New Upgrade! Highlights of Marvelous Designer 2024.2 Features Overview
description:
Explore new feature optimizations to enhance your Marvelous Designer workflow efficiency:

✨ GPU Simulation Optimization  
Achieve the same collision handling accuracy as CPU simulation; now, animation recording and precise fabric simulation are no longer limited to CPU solving; you can also choose GPU for animation recording and more precise fabric solving.  
✨ Soft Selection Dragging Fabric Range  
You can now switch to the soft selection dragging feature during simulation, allowing you to drag a small piece of fabric and achieve a more natural dragging transition effect through the weight settings of soft selection.  
✨ Maintain Conflicts During Attachment Simulation  
Attachments can now interact with fabric in real-time under the influence of gravity while participating in fabric collisions, helping you to create more realistic physical forms for assets like backpacks that have many accessories.  
✨ Improved Automatic Conversion of Quad Surface Algorithm  
In the new version, we have improved the quad surface (optimization) algorithm; the automatically converted quad surfaces will now be neater and cleaner.

Feel free to message us to join groups for learning, discussion, and exchange!

summary: # Brand New Upgrade! Highlights of Marvelous Designer 2024.2 Features Overview ## Introduction In this video, we explore the exciting new features and upgrades of Marvelous Designer 2024.2. This release brings a host of enhancements that are designed to elevate the user experience and expand the creative possibilities for designers. ## New Features Overview Marvelous Designer 2024.2 includes several noteworthy upgrades that improve functionality and performance. Below are the highlights of these new features: ### Enhanced User Interface The user interface has undergone significant improvements, making it more intuitive and user-friendly. Key elements of the UI have been redesigned for better accessibility and streamlined workflows. ### Performance Improvements This version introduces optimized performance metrics, allowing for faster rendering times and smoother interactions within the software. Users can expect enhanced responsiveness, particularly when working with complex designs. ### Advanced Simulation Capabilities Marvelous Designer 2024.2 features advanced simulation capabilities that enable more realistic fabric behavior. This includes improved cloth physics and the ability to simulate various fabric types with greater accuracy. ### New Fabric Library The updated fabric library now includes a wider range of materials and textures. Designers can choose from an extensive selection of fabrics to better represent their creative visions. ### Collaboration Tools This release enhances collaboration features, allowing multiple users to work on the same project seamlessly. Real-time updates and shared resources facilitate teamwork and creative synergy among designers. ## Conclusion Marvelous Designer 2024.2 is a robust upgrade packed with features that enhance the design process. With its improved interface, performance, simulation capabilities, and collaboration tools, this version is set to empower designers and elevate their creative output.
